offering_description.value: Provides lease-to-own plans and four-installment payment options for retail shoppers, plus mobile cash advances for consumers between paychecks. It delivers these through digital platforms and retail channels and provides employers with a financial wellness program that lets employees buy goods and services through payroll deduction.

quotes.quote: Progressive Leasing is a leading provider of e-commerce, app-based, and in-store lease-to-own solutions that provide transparent and competitive payment options with flexible terms to help consumers of all financial backgrounds achieve merchandise ownership. Since its founding Progressive Leasing has helped millions of consumers acquire furniture, appliances, jewelry, electronics, mattresses, cell phones, and other products consumers need by utilizing a technology-based proprietary platform that provides instant decisioning results.

Purchasing Power is a voluntary benefit company providing financial wellness solutions to employers, including a leading employee purchase program for consumer products and services using payroll deduction. Helping employees achieve financial flexibility, Purchasing Power is available to millions of people through large companies including Fortune 500s, associations and government agencies.

quotes.quote: Four Technologies is a Miami, Florida-based financial technology company that provides consumers with Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solutions. Its innovative platform, Four, allows retailers to provide greater payment flexibility to shoppers through the option to pay for merchandise through four interest-free installments, while enhancing the retailers’ revenues through increased transaction volume and ticket size.

MoneyApp is a simple, digital cash‑advance app that helps people cover everyday expenses when they need extra flexibility between paychecks. Customers can access funds quickly and manage short‑term needs with confidence, all through an easy‑to‑use mobile experience. MoneyApp is part of PROG Holdings’ broader mission to expand access to practical, inclusive financial solutions.
